title: feature-flags.json
description: Output contract for the feature-flag coding-agent skill set. Records what net-new user-facing code (if any) was wrapped behind an Amplitude Experiment flag, default-OFF, and the verdict for the run. This is the single source of truth referenced by generate-flags-manifest and the /add-feature-flags orchestrator. NOTE: wrap_locations[] is model-authored and NOT authoritative — the PR diff is ground truth. The langley server-side ship gate (a real, non-empty wrap diff), not the advisory_only boolean, decides whether a PR ships.

detected_integration.description: What Amplitude Experiment integration the discover-experiment-integration stage found in the repo. Drives whether code can be wrapped (Wrapped) or only suggested (Advisory).

sdk.description: Which Experiment SDK surface the repo integrates. 'none' when no high-confidence integration was found (forces advisory_only).

package.description: The detected SDK package, e.g. '@amplitude/experiment-js-client' (client) or '@amplitude/experiment-node-server' (server).

import_path.description: Where the repo imports/initializes the experiment client from, so generated wraps reuse it (extend-before-add).

init_pattern.description: A representative initialization snippet from the repo, e.g. "Experiment.initialize('DEPLOYMENT_KEY')".

deployment.description: Optional. The Amplitude Experiment deployment the integration is wired to. A deployment is the container (with its own key) that serves flags/experiments; ONE app/project can have MULTIPLE deployments, so this is a dimension below app_id. Detection is best-effort: the deployment key in code is usually an env var or constant, not a literal, so this records how it was identified rather than the secret itself. Multiple wired deployments, a key that can't be tied to a known deployment, or per-environment keys all LOWER confidence (handled in the discovery/confidence step) — they do not need to be fully resolved here.

key_source.description: Where the deployment key comes from, e.g. "env:EXPERIMENT_DEPLOYMENT_KEY" or "const:DEPLOYMENT_KEY in src/lib/experiment.ts". Never store the raw key value.

multiple_detected.description: True if more than one deployment / deployment key appears wired in the repo (e.g. distinct client and server keys, or per-environment keys). A signal for the confidence evaluation.

guard_pattern.description: A representative existing flag-guard snippet from the repo, e.g. "experiment.variant('key').value === 'on'", so generated guards match local convention. Omit if none exist.

confidence.description: Best-effort confidence the integration is real and usable. 'low' (ambiguous / test-only / vendored import) routes the run to advisory_only.

advisory_only.description: True when net-new user-facing surfaces exist but no high-confidence Experiment SDK integration was found — the run suggests flags but wraps no code. The langley ship gate, not this boolean, makes the final ship decision.

no_flaggable_surfaces.description: True when the diff has no net-new user-facing behavior worth flagging (refactor/bugfix/config/test/generated/bot). When true, flags[] is empty and the flow produces no comment, no PR, no row.

flags.description: One entry per flag. Empty when no_flaggable_surfaces is true. In advisory_only mode entries carry definition + rationale but wrap_locations may be empty (nothing was wrapped).

key.description: Flag key, derived from the feature/surface. Preserved verbatim if it matches an existing key surfaced by discovery (never rename). Casing convention is defined by the define-feature-flags skill.

surface.description: Short human label for the net-new user-facing surface this flag gates.

files.description: Repo-relative file paths this flag touches (informational; the diff is ground truth).

rationale.description: Why this net-new code is wrapped, framed as a code change to review (not a telemetry add).

variant_values.description: Variant values. v1 is binary; default ['off','on']. Targeting/multi-variant is phase 2.

default.description: The default/control variant. Always 'off' in v1 (dark launch).

wrap_locations.description: Where the guard was inserted. MODEL-AUTHORED, NOT AUTHORITATIVE — the PR diff is ground truth. Empty in advisory_only mode.

file.description: Repo-relative path where the guard sits AFTER edits.

line.description: 1-indexed line of the guard after edits (adjusted for insertions earlier in the same file).

what_it_wraps.description: One sentence on the net-new behavior this guard gates.
